answer: Here is one concrete wall: Camera-signed photo provenance with C2PA manifest. It works because photos signed inside the camera with a manifest no editor can backdate, and the hollow it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the lagoon is that the farm's unit economics never work. The lantern is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
